mission_description: Rewrite the current OpenCode fork into a coherent template-driven agent runtime with strong permissions, session timeline, canonical protocol, workflow DSL, memory, and release gates.

features.task_summary: Stabilize and document the current phase-1 worktree before further implementation.
expectedBehavior: Current diff is mapped to modules
Focused phase-1 verification commands are documented
Temporary diagnostics are identified
verificationSteps: Verify the inventory matches the diff against origin/dev
Verify focused phase-1 typecheck and tests pass from packages/opencode
features.audit_notes: PASS after re-review: Temporary Diagnostics now includes server.ts /agent route temp log; MOD-00 inventory and acceptance checklist verified.

features.task_summary: Finalize agent template schema semantics and validation fixtures.
expectedBehavior: Agent meta schema is stable
Default template parses cleanly
Invalid template shapes produce deterministic diagnostics
verificationSteps: Verify schema tests cover required, optional, invalid, and fixture cases
Verify default agent meta parses without warnings
features.audit_notes: PASS after re-review: structured workflow and permission semantics, full-path validateTemplate, and whitespace rejection verified. Typecheck and schema tests passed.

features.task_summary: Make template loading, precedence, cache invalidation, registry access, and CLI validation robust.
expectedBehavior: Package and user templates load deterministically
Malformed templates do not break valid templates
Registry exposes stable list/get/default/switch behavior
verificationSteps: Verify loader and registry tests pass with package and user fixtures
Verify no production code writes ad hoc agent logs to /tmp
features.audit_notes: PASS after re-review: compaction/title templates present, shared permission builder respects schema semantics and user deny precedence, registry switch test covers effective agent, temp logs absent.

features.task_summary: Inject agent identity and rules into runtime prompts while preserving provider transforms and session context.
expectedBehavior: Identity and rules appear in prompt messages in stable order
Project instructions and provider transforms still apply
Default-only installs do not break title or compaction flows
verificationSteps: Verify prompt tests include identity and rules sections
Verify compaction and title flows work when only the default template exists
features.audit_notes: PASS: identity/rules prompt order, model system message injection, provider transform ordering, fallback behavior, and registry switch behavior reviewed.

features.task_summary: Remove stale skill runtime, config, command, TUI, and documentation surfaces or convert them to explicit migration warnings.
expectedBehavior: Deleted skill source has no runtime references
TUI and commands no longer expose dead skill UI
Users see a documented migration path
verificationSteps: Verify source search only finds intentional skill compatibility notes
Verify config and TUI tests cover unsupported skill behavior
features.audit_notes: PASS after re-review: legacy markdown agent compatibility restored, SDK/OpenAPI skill surface removed, TUI busy->running fix validated.

features.task_summary: Replace the plugin no-op stub with explicit fork behavior across auth, tools, providers, shell env, and UI.
expectedBehavior: No production code depends on plugin-stub
Provider auth exposes only supported methods
Tool and shell extension behavior is first-class or intentionally removed
verificationSteps: Verify production source has no plugin-stub imports
Verify provider, tool registry, shell, and TUI status tests pass without plugin hooks
features.audit_notes: PASS after re-review: Config.plugin removed from runtime/OpenAPI, unsupported OAuth returns ProviderAuth error mapped to 400, plugin flag removed, plugin-stub/Plugin call sites absent.

features.task_summary: Introduce explicit capability, policy, inheritance, and six-dimensional permission modules behind the compatibility facade.
expectedBehavior: Permission decisions are derived from capability and policy modules
Inheritance sources are explicit
PermissionNext remains only as a compatibility facade
verificationSteps: Verify capability, policy, inheritance, and six-dimensional matcher tests pass
Verify existing permission compatibility tests still pass
features.audit_notes: PASS after re-review: inspection route/OpenAPI/SDK consistent, trace preserves source layers, lax/core ask-deny precedence and six-dimensional matching reviewed.

features.task_summary: Complete permission approval APIs, pending request isolation, TUI decision trace, and audit events.
expectedBehavior: Pending approvals are scoped by session and workspace
Once, always, reject, and feedback flows are deterministic
Users can inspect why a permission is requested
verificationSteps: Verify approval route tests cover once, always, reject, and feedback
Verify TUI permission UI shows requested action, pattern, and source rule
features.audit_notes: PASS after re-review: deprecated session permission reply route maps not_found/forbidden, validates session/workspace, regression tests cover unknown/mismatched/cross-workspace cases.

features.task_summary: Formalize legal session status transitions and make prompt, question, error, retry, and permission flows update status consistently.
expectedBehavior: All six statuses have documented transition behavior
Prompt lifecycle returns to idle
Runtime failures and retries expose deterministic state
verificationSteps: Verify state transition tests cover valid and invalid transitions
Verify prompt, question, error, retry, and permission flows set expected status
features.audit_notes: MOD-08 re-review PASS: nested waiting_permission/waiting_user flows restore prior status; /session/{sessionID}/status route OpenAPI SDK are consistent; processor non-retry runtime errors set error and rethrow; lifecycle and route tests cover the changes.

features.task_summary: Complete checkpoint metadata, restore validation, restore endpoints, and optional visible restore flow.
expectedBehavior: Checkpoints include snapshot, permission, and dsl context metadata
Restore validates session ownership
API exposes list and restore safely
verificationSteps: Verify restore recovers files, permissions, and dsl context
Verify invalid or unrelated checkpoint hashes fail safely
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: list/preview/restore share strict workspace/directory guard; session.workspaceID requires matching WorkspaceContext.workspaceID; directory guard remains; previous OpenAPI, Snapshot.restore, and real restore test findings resolved.

features.task_summary: Align project-scoped APIs with workspace and worktree isolation so one instance can serve multiple projects.
expectedBehavior: Project APIs match the revised spec
Sessions are isolated by workspace and project
Multi-worktree access does not leak state
verificationSteps: Verify project route tests cover list, init, session list, session get, and session create
Verify cross-workspace session access is forbidden
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: project session list forces Instance.directory and rejects mismatched query.directory; project session get/status use bound() directory guard; tests cover same-project multi-worktree cross-directory rejection and same-directory success; previous workspaceID and OpenAPI findings resolved.

features.task_summary: Define ordered event envelopes, replay, filtering, route contracts, OpenAPI docs, and regenerated JavaScript SDK.
expectedBehavior: Events are ordered and replayable
Subscriptions filter by session and workspace
Generated SDK matches server routes
verificationSteps: Verify replay and filtering tests return ordered event streams
Verify JavaScript SDK regenerates and compiles after route changes
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: replay/live transition drains buffer until empty before live=true; seen/last preserve no-dup and monotonic sequence; regression test covers final flush boundary. Previous workspace filter, workspace server envelope, global event filter/replay, and OpenAPI/SDK findings resolved.

features.task_summary: Adapt TUI to template agents, status visibility, permission traces, checkpoint restore, and removal of stale skill/plugin surfaces.
expectedBehavior: User can see current agent and session status
User can switch agents and approve permissions
No stale skill or plugin UI remains
verificationSteps: Verify terminal UI visibly renders agent, status, permission, and error states
Verify agent switch affects the next prompt without losing session history
features.audit_notes: Re-review PASS: agent picker is server-backed via sync.data.agent; current agent initializes from default_agent/first server agent and respects user selection; header aggregates visible child waiting_permission/waiting_user before route status; target tests cover server agents/default/user choice, child pending aggregate, non-default prompt agent and history preservation.

features.task_summary: Build workflow schema, loader, parser, executor, pause/resume, checkpoint integration, routes, and visible progress.
expectedBehavior: Valid workflows parse and execute
Workflow state persists in dsl context
Paused workflows resume after permission or user input
verificationSteps: Verify schema, parser, executor, guard, pause, resume, and checkpoint tests pass
Verify a user can see current workflow progress in CLI or TUI
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: precise WorkflowPauseGuard prevents approved:true from skipping later permission guards; Session.setDslContext enforces project/directory/workspace guard with 403 route contract; SDK workflow required-param post-process fails fast and type test remains. No new Blocker/Critical found.

features.task_summary: Implement session memory extraction, Qdrant adapter, chunk policy, semantic retrieval, reranking, API, and subagent isolation.
expectedBehavior: Session summaries and selected chunks are indexed
Memories can be retrieved by semantic query and filters
Subagent memory isolation and sharing are enforced
verificationSteps: Verify memory adapter contract tests pass
Verify project, session, topic, and subagent isolation filters return expected memories
features.audit_notes: Re-review PASS: memory search requires workspace and rejects child sessionID; store rejects workspace-bound searches without workspace; capture avoids tool output and filters secrets/bash/log; capture failures are best-effort; adapter upsert is bounded to candidates; OpenAPI/SDK body required with type test. No new Blocker/Critical/Major found.

features.task_summary: Add audit taxonomy, metrics, traces, regression scenarios, performance checks, failure-mode tests, and CI phase gates.
expectedBehavior: Core decisions and lifecycle events are auditable
Metrics and traces cover critical runtime paths
Regression gates catch behavior drift
verificationSteps: Verify audit, metrics, trace, regression, and performance tests pass
Verify CI commands execute the same documented phase gates
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: permission.audit replied payload only emits reply/feedback without raw message while permission.replied remains separate; gate:mod15 runs check:sdk, which snapshots, rebuilds, diffs saved OpenAPI/SDK generated outputs, fails on mismatch, and restores dirty worktree. No new severe issue found.

features.task_summary: Clean package metadata, remove dead dependencies, regenerate SDK, write migration docs, run full checks, and prepare a release candidate.
expectedBehavior: The fork has no accidental package metadata or dead imports
Full checks are run from the correct package directories
Migration and release docs are complete
verificationSteps: Verify full package typecheck and tests pass from packages/opencode
Verify release documentation covers agents, skills, plugins, permissions, sessions, workflow, and memory
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: bin.jin exists as executable 100755 working-tree artifact matching package bin.jin and npm pack dry-run includes it; ghostty-web lock ref restored to 4af877d with no 20bd361; MOD-16 evidence and RC checklist include bin/jin checks. No new severe issue found.

features.task_summary: Remove user-facing workspaceID and make resolved directory the sole workspace boundary across sessions, permissions, timeline, workflow, memory, audit, TUI, SDK, docs, and tests.
expectedBehavior: Starting in a directory is sufficient to define the workspace
No user-facing API or TUI path requires workspaceID
Core isolation is enforced by resolved directory
Agent defaults use explicit custom per-agent permissions
verificationSteps: Verify session, permission, timeline, workflow, memory, and audit isolation tests pass using directory only
Verify OpenAPI/SDK no longer require workspace query/header for normal flows
Verify default agent permissions come from custom agent config
Verify full package checks pass or blockers are documented
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: ordinary server no longer constructs WorkspaceContext from workspace query/header and WorkspaceRouterMiddleware does not proxy normal API calls; directory query/header is compatibility-validated against the current server directory and cannot switch Instance.directory; fallback default agent uses custom permission mode; permission reply 403 is represented in route/OpenAPI/SDK contracts; remaining setWorkspace naming is legacy UI/control-plane terminology with no runtime boundary risk. Full opencode tests 1614 pass/8 skip, typechecks and SDK build/typecheck passed.
